title: Volcanoes of Ethiopia (guided)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Ethiopia, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders to help you.

rounds.name: Mallahle
rounds.fact: Mallahle is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 1,875 m in the source data. The data places it in Ethiopia.
